description: This file implements the ClientController class for managing client connections, shared memory, and application state transitions within the Rialto client component. It includes methods for registering/unregistering clients, initializing and terminating shared memory, and notifying clients of state changes.

classes.name: ClientController
classes.description: Manages client registration, shared memory, and application state notifications within the Rialto client.

methods.name: IClientControllerAccessor::instance
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of the ClientControllerAccessor.

methods.name: ClientControllerAccessor::getClientController
methods.description: Returns a reference to the singleton ClientController instance.

methods.name: ClientController::ClientController
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ClientController, sets up IPC, and registers the client.

methods.name: ClientController::~ClientController
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up shared memory.

methods.name: ClientController::getSharedMemoryHandle
methods.description: Returns the current shared memory handle.

methods.name: ClientController::registerClient
methods.description: Registers a client and retrieves the current application state.

methods.name: ClientController::initSharedMemory
methods.description: Initializes shared memory by requesting it via IPC.

methods.name: ClientController::termSharedMemory
methods.description: Terminates shared memory by resetting the handle.

methods.name: ClientController::notifyApplicationState
methods.description: Handles application state changes, including shared memory management and client notifications.

methods.name: ClientController::stateToString
methods.description: Converts application state enum to string.

methods.name: ClientController::changeStateAndNotifyClients
methods.description: Updates the current state and notifies all registered clients.
